requirements.title: Add task
requirements.text: The system shall let the user add a task by entering a text description.
acceptanceCriteria: Entering text and confirming adds a new task to the list
The new task is shown as not done
An empty task description is not added

requirements.title: Mark task done
requirements.text: The system shall let the user mark a task as done.
acceptanceCriteria: Ticking a task changes it to the done state
The done state is visibly distinguishable from the not-done state

requirements.title: Persist tasks
requirements.text: The system shall keep the user's tasks and their done state available when the user closes the app and returns later.
acceptanceCriteria: After adding tasks and ticking some, closing and reopening the app shows the same tasks with the same done states

requirements.title: Run in browser
requirements.text: The system shall be usable in a web browser.
acceptanceCriteria: All features are usable in a web browser without installing additional software

openQuestions.text: Where should tasks be stored? Browser-only storage (simple, but only that browser on that device) or on a server (available from other devices, needs a backend)?
Should you be able to untick a task to mark it as not done again?
Do you need to edit or delete tasks?
Should done tasks stay in the list, move to a separate section, or be hideable?
Is a task just a text description, or do you want extras such as due date, priority or categories?
